name: project_block_visual_and_paragraph
title: Project Block - Visual and Paragraph
description: Single card: post visual + paragraph with tags, then an optional full-width text_extra. Mode "wrap" (default): plain image (200px, max 100%, height auto) floated left/right with the text flowing next to and under it, stacked below sm. Mode "columns": visual and text side by side through the columns component (40-60 from sm, 30-70 at md, 40-60 from lg; changeable with data.columns), image with a fixed height (cover) and overlay_noise. Without data.image the visual is post_short_info_visual (post logo). Tags: block_tags with a chevron instead of the # prefix (tags_prefix). All text comes from data - nothing is generated.
